title: Jared Birchall, a Mormon elder, as Elon Musk's handler

tellings.quote: connection is Elon's like basically like sort of handler like his like the man who manages all of his affairs.

plain: A Mormon elder named Jared Birchall is, in effect, the handler of the businessman Elon Musk: "the man who manages all of his affairs." The researcher Matthew Pines says this in a 2024 talk with Michels and names no source. He offers it as a connection worth noticing, because if true it would put a church figure at the center of one of the best-known businessmen's lives.
